sector.quote: Operates as a comprehensive importer and distributor of lighting products, including lamps, luminaires, street lighting poles, and related products under proprietary brands, ENRICH and RICH, as well as through OEM arrangements and third-party brands.

business_description.value: The company imports and distributes lighting products such as lamps, luminaires and street lighting poles under its own ENRICH and RICH brands, OEM arrangements and third-party brands. It also provides lighting system design and consultancy, and distributes and installs solar energy systems.
business_description.quote: The business also provides lighting system design and consultancy services, and engages in the distribution and installation of solar energy systems.
